source: CDC WONDER Underlying Cause of Death, 1999-2020 (controller D76)

request.protocol: XML data API POST (request_xml + accept_datause_restrictions), one request, no key; request parameters match the live-validated query in xh1b scraper/scraper/wonder.py (probed 2026-09-06)

contents.suppression: cells with <10 deaths are suppressed in the source; none of the 2015-2019 pooled strata used for profile rows contain suppressed cells
contents.population_semantics: July 1 census population estimate per year; pooled person-years = sum of annual populations across 2015-2019

derivation.profile_window: 2015-2019 pooled, rate = deaths / person-years (event per person-year)
derivation.reproduction_check: male 45-54 pooled 2015-2019 reproduces the 2026-09-06 warehouse pin exactly: 514314 / 104024440 = 494.4 per 100k = baselines.csv:all_cause_mortality_annual

integration_status: verified national rate profiles (params/mortality_profiles.csv rows *_2015_2019). County-level exports are NOT available from this API (county grouping is web-export-only; queued extraction #31). This file is a national aggregate and is never a county baseline.
